rounding: Thresholds compare as written (>=, <=, >, <), on values rounded to 9 places; a missing value is a miss unless the rule says 'does not apply'. Bands include their ends.

terms.new pool: problems never solved in 64 no-think samples (0 of 16, then 0 of 48 fresh), after the guards; never called 'absent'
terms.known pool: problems solved in >= 36 of 48 fresh samples (>= 24 in a MATH level-5 stratum whose known at 36 are fewer than its new; pools.json meta.fallback names them), after the guards
terms.n: pools.json meta.n: problems per pool, train plus held (both pools have the same n by construction)

stage0.on_miss: the job stops (exit 2); nothing else runs

stage1_early.on_miss: GSM8K truncation or MATH truncation at cap 2048 on the first shard, or the level-5 share after pass 16: stop (exit 2). MATH truncation over 0.10 at 1024 redoes the first shard at 2048.

n1_control.rule: known pool (train + held) solved at least once in 4 think-mode samples
n1_control.on_miss: N1 stops before the new pool; P2 reads 'no call'

P1.claim: the new pool has at least 100 problems after the guards
P1.edge_cases: empty new pool: n = 0, reads no. A stratum with new but no known problems is dropped from both sides and counted (meta.strata cut_new_unmatched), it never errors. n exactly 100 reads yes. Stage 1 stopped (level-5 share under 0.05): no pools.json, reads no.

P2.claim: novelty check N1 passes: at most half of the new pool is solved with thinking on
P2.rule: results/n1.json new.solved_share = share of new-pool problems (train + held) with at least 1 of 4 think-mode samples correct (the card's thinking settings T 0.6, top-p 0.95, top-k 20; 8,192-token cap; only the text after </think> is graded, a sample without </think> or truncated is not solved); passes if <= 0.5
P2.on_fail: the lead stops and asks the user (a changed definition of 'new' is the user's); option 3 only below 100 problems
P2.edge_cases: empty new pool: does not apply. Exactly 0.5 passes. Known-pool control under 0.8: no call, reported as read. Every sample truncated: solved 0, reads pass, so n1.json truncation is reported beside it and a truncation over 0.5 is named in the write-up.

P3.claim: the new arm learns by the held-out rule
P3.rule: at step 100, per seed, held-out pass@1 = mean over the new pool's held problems of (correct of 8 samples at qwen_eval.SAMPLE)/8, graded by grade.py; learns if >= 0.10 for both seeds, no if < 0.10 for both, 'seeds disagree' otherwise. With held-out < 0.10, trained-part greedy >= 0.5 reads 'memorised, carrying little' (E84's label).
P3.expected: no, 0.35 for learns: memorised, carrying little
P3.edge_cases: empty held part: does not apply. Exactly 0.10 reads learns. W0's held-out pass@1 is at most 1/64 per problem by construction, so the bar is not passed by the do-nothing state unless the held part is tiny: with n >= 100 the held part has >= 20 problems.

P4.claim: the known arm leaves GSM8K test within 0.05 of W0
P4.rule: at step 100, per seed, GSM8K test 0-255 greedy strict accuracy on fitting answers (qwen_eval.score, strict_dropped, fp32 forward) minus W0's 0.784 (experiments/qwen_recipe/results/train_W.json -> states.w0.unprompted.strict_dropped, the same path); holds if |difference| <= 0.05 for both seeds
P4.expected: uncertain; the D2 gold arm at the same recipe read 0.598 at step 100 (train_W.json -> states.gold_s0_100), a drop of 0.19
P4.edge_cases: a seed missing: no call. Exactly 0.05 holds. Do-nothing (W0 itself) reads 0 and holds, as it should: this is a no-damage rule.

P5.claim: at step 100 the new arm's update is larger than the known arm's
P5.rule: per seed s, Frobenius norm of the fp32 delta W over the 196 decomposed matrices at step 100, new seed s > known seed s; holds if for both seeds, fails if for neither, 'mixed' otherwise
P5.edge_cases: equal norms read 'not larger'. A missing step-100 file: no call for that seed.
